chapter.verse: Ei' tunga Pa' hong piak itna bangci nam cih lungngai un. Tua itna hangin eite Pasian' tate hong kici a, zong i hi takpi hi. Leitung in ei hong theih loh pen Pasian nathei lo ahih man hi.

Kong itte aw, tu-in eite Pasian' tate i hi a, bangci dan hi lai ding cih hong kilang nailo hi. Himah taleh amah hong kilat ciangin amah tawh kibang ding i hihlam i thei hi. A hang pen amah ahi bangin mu ding i hih man hi.
Tua hi a, amah siangtho ahih mah bangin ama' sungah lametna a nei khempeuh amaumah kisiansuah uh hi.
Mawhna a bawl khempeuh thukhun a pampaih ahi hi; mawhna pen thukhun pampaihna hi.
Mawhnate a puakhia dingin Khris hong kilang a, ama' sungah mawhna om lo hi.
Ama' sunga omte in mawhna bawlbawl lo uh a, mawhna a bawlbawlte pen amah a mu nailo, a thei nailo ahi hi.
Tanote aw, kuamah' khemin om kei un. Khris midik ahih mah bangin dikna thu a zui khempeuh midik ahi hi.
Dawimangpa ahihleh a kipatcil pan mawhna bawlbawl ahih manin mawhna a bawlte dawimangpa' pawl ahi hi. Pasian' Tapa hong kilatna a hang pen dawimangpa' nasep teng a phelzan ding ahih man hi.
Pasian' sungpana suakte amau' sungah Pasian' khaici omkip ahih manin mawhna bawlbawl lo uh hi. Pasian' sungpan suak uh ahih manin mawhna bawlbawl nuamlo uh hi.
Kuate Pasian' tate hi-a kuate dawimangpa' tate cih pen hih bangin hong kilang hi: dikna thu a nuntakpih lo khempeuh, ahihkeileh a sanggamte a it lo khempeuh, Pasian' sungpan hilo uh hi.
A hang pen a kipatcil pan na zak khitsa uh thu pen eite khatlekhat ki-it ding, cih ahi hi.

Gilopa' pawl ahi, a sanggampa a that Cain tawh i kibat loh ding kisam hi. Tua ahihleh Cain in bang hangin a naupa that ahi hiam? Ama' sepkhiat pen siahuai-in a naupa' sepkhiat ahihleh thutang ahih man hi.
Sanggamte aw, leitung in note hong muhdah pen lamdang sa kei un.
Sanggamte it i hih manin sihna pan nuntakna ah galkah khinzo i hihlam i thei hi.
A sanggamte a mudah khempeuh mithat hi a, mithat peuhmah a sungah tawntung nuntakna omkip lo ahihlam na thei uh hi.
Itna i theihcianzia hih bang hi: Khris in eite' taangin a nuntakna luuikhia a, eite zong sanggamte' adingin i nuntaknate i luuikhiat ding ahi hi.
Ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in leitung vanlenate nei henla a sanggamte cimawh cih theikha napi lainatna a neih keileh ama' sungah Pasian' itna bangci omkip thei ding ahi hiam?
Tanote aw, eite i hihleh a thu bek leh kampau bek tawh a ki-it hilo-in sepkhiatna leh thumaan thutak tawh a ki-it hizaw ni.
Tua hileh thumaan thutak tawh teeng i hihna leh ama' mai-ah lungmuang i hihna i theician ding hi.
A hang pen i lungsim in ei hong mawhsak leh Pasian pen i lungsim sangin lianzaw-in amah in na khempeuh thei hi.
Kong itte aw, i lungsim in ei hong mawhsak kei-a leh Pasian' mai-ah sunglam kimuanna i nei a,
hong thupiaknate zui-in amah a lungkimsak thute sem i hih manin i nget bangbang ama' kiangpan i ngah ding hi.
Tua hi a, ama' thupiakna hih bang ahi hi: Ama' Tapa Jesu Khris' min um ding, cih thu leh hong thupiak bangin eite khatlekhat ki-it ding, cih ahi hi.
Pasian' thupiaknate a zui khempeuh Pasian' sungah a omkip hi a, ama' sungah zong Pasian omkip hi. I sungah amah om ahihlam, hong piaksa Kha tungtawnin i theician hi.
